subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be exposed by automatically grouping existing mediaUrls, by adding an explicit media-group action/parameter, or by deferring album grouping and documenting sequential sends?
rationale: The remaining work adds user-visible Telegram message-tool/channel behavior and spans direct actions, reply delivery, and outbound payload delivery, so an automated fix should not choose the permanent API shape or fallback policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Group eligible mediaUrls at the Telegram boundary
options.body: Reuse the existing durable mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only when the media set is Telegram-groupable, with sequential fallback for single, non-groupable, or failed album sends.

options.title: Rework the draft explicit action
options.body: Use the linked draft PR's explicit send-media-group action shape as the product direction, but ask for a current-main rewrite and proof before landing.

options.title: Keep sequential sends for now
options.body: Defer album grouping and document that multi-media Telegram sends currently deliver as separate messages.

recommendation.title: Group eligible mediaUrls at the Telegram boundary
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing durable mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only when the media set is Telegram-groupable, with sequential fallback for single, non-groupable, or failed album sends.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and has the strongest current routing signal across the central Telegram send/action/reply files.
